title: Study Evaluating Streptococcus Pneumoniae Serotype Carriage Rate for Nasopharyngeal Carriage in Filipino Children
brief_summary: Evaluation of the carriage rate of Streptococcus pneumoniae in the nasopharynx of healthy children and the carriage rate and distribution of Streptococcus pneumoniae serotypes
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy children aged between 2 months and 5 years attending the well baby clinic in hospital.
* Informed consent obtained from parents or legal guardian.
